notes.title: Announcement on Game Content and Pricing Model Adjustments
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We will be implementing a series of changes to the game soon, aimed at enhancing the overall gaming experience. Below are the specific adjustments that will be made:

[h3]Change in Pricing Model[/h3]
We will be adjusting the pricing model to create a fairer and more sustainable gaming environment for all players. Please stay tuned for further announcements.

[h3]Full Access to Fruits & New Content[/h3]
All fruits will be fully unlocked, and we’re introducing new content: Apple Pie, Pear Pie, Watermelon Pie, and Banana Pie Girls have been added to the game. We hope these fresh additions will bring you even more enjoyment!

[h3]Adjustment to Fruit Drop Quantities[/h3]
To balance the in-game economy, the quantity of all fruit drops will be reduced to one-tenth of their original amounts. The specific adjustments are as follows:

[list]
[*] Default Common: 1000 units
[*] Advanced: 666 units
[*] Rare: 168 units
[*] Legendary: 20 units
[/list]

[h3]Some Fruits Becoming Unavailable[/h3]
We have decided to phase out four groups of fruits: Apple, Watermelon, Banana, and Pear. These fruits will no longer drop in future updates.

Thank you for your continued support and understanding. We will keep working to bring you an even better gaming experience. If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to reach out to us in the community.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: July 16th Update Announcement! All vulnerabilities have been fixed!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are pleased to inform you that after a few days of restructuring the program code, [b]we have now completely fixed all game vulnerabilities while retaining all original game functions[/b]. Our team has been working diligently to ensure a safe and enjoyable experience for all players.

[b]We are offering the following compensation plan: All users who have participated in the game will receive a free activation code for the highly rated game "LUNAR LICH" (97% positive reviews). 
(Note: You need to join our official chat group to receive the code, group number: 1143247188)[/b]

We appreciate your patience and understanding during this time. The updated version will be released as soon as possible. Stay tuned for more updates!

Thank you for your continued support.

Best regards,
Twilight Sonata Studio

notes.title: New Game "Fruit: Chain Effect" Set for Release on July 12, 2024
notes.content:
Get ready for a fruity adventure! We are thrilled to announce the upcoming release of our latest game, "Fruit: Chain Effect," which will be available on July 12, 2024. This highly anticipated game promises to bring fun and excitement to players of all ages.

[b]"Fruit: Chain Effect" is a captivating connect-pair puzzle game bursting with vibrant colors and delicious fruits. Players will embark on an extraordinary journey through various fruit-themed scenes, enjoying a perfect blend of strategy and fun.[/b]

[h3]Game Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Good Economy:[/b] Fruits are dropped in limited quantities, preventing market crashes and ensuring each fruit is valuable.
[*][b]Fruit Item Synthesis and Decomposition Exchange:[/b] Equip and use fruit skins in the game. Synthesize same-level fruit items for personalized and strategic gameplay. Decompose unwanted fruit items to exchange for unique, limited-edition premium fruits.
[*][b]Diverse Fruit Backgrounds:[/b] Explore a variety of visually delightful fruit scenes in each level.
Innovative Connect Gameplay: Experience new elements added to classic connect gameplay, enhancing strategic depth within simple rules.
[*]Exquisite Sound Effects and Background Music: Enjoy pleasing sound effects and relaxing background music for a comprehensive gaming experience.
[*][b]Item Drop System:[/b] Earn rare fruits randomly while playing online. Collect up to 120 types of fruit skins, including legendary, premium, rare, advanced, and common varieties.
[*][b]Market Drop Trading Support:[/b] Trade rare fruits through the market drop trading system, adding more fun and community interaction.
[*]Game Leaderboards and Rewards: Challenge the leaderboards and win generous rewards for ranking high. Showcase your match-3 skills and earn glory and valuable prizes.
[*][b]Original Soundtrack Music: [/b]Enjoy up to 12 original soundtrack songs that add more fun and atmosphere to the game.
[/list]

Mark your calendars and stay tuned for more updates as we approach the release date. We can't wait for you to experience the endless fun of fruit elimination in the world of "Fruit: Chain Effect"!
